newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates moderately quoted.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates moderately quoted.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were moderately quoted on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus none on Monday.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week of July, bid 115 percent of tariff, offered 120 - no comparison on either value.
- Four barges, Mississippi (Memphis through Cairo), one each week August, bid 95 percent - no comparison, no offer.
- Four barges, Mississippi (Memphis through Cairo), one each week September, bid 135 percent - no comparison, no offer.
- Four barges, Illinois, one each week of September, bid 165 percent of tariff, offered 175 - no comparison on either value.
- Four barges, Mississippi (McGregor and south), one each week of October, bid 240 percent, offered 250 - no comparison on either value.
- Four barges, Illinois, one each week of November, bid 175 percent - no comparison, no offer.
- Four barges, Illinois, one each week of December, bid 162-1/2 percent, offered 170 - no comparison on either value.
